name: How long does stucco re-coating take?
description: Stucco re-coating usually takes a few days to a week for an average home, depending on size, repairs, and weather conditions.

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco re-coating take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a stucco re-coating project depends on the size of the area to be coated, the extent of any necessary repairs, and weather conditions. For an average-sized home, the process typically takes a few days to a week, including preparation, repair work, and application of the re-coating material. Larger or more complex projects, or those requiring extensive repairs, may take longer. Our team will provide a timeline estimate during the consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco re-coating usually takes a few days to a week for an average home, depending on size, repairs, and weather conditions.
